questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Ancylostoma duodenale?
options: Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Segmented eggs in fresh stool; larvae may occur after specimen delay.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Segmented eggs in fresh stool; larvae may occur after specimen delay. Wet mount or concentration at 100–400×; species resolution requires molecular or appropriately validated larval/adult identification.

references.title: Molecular identification of hookworms in Thailand
